text_block_list.text:
One day, in the academy's cafeteria,
I saw Cheval Grand with a deeply troubled look on her face...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I can't decide... but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Whoa!
T-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um... It seems like the cafe staff
made a mistaken order――"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If you order the large 'Sweet and Sour Pork Fried Rice Set',
they say right now you get a mega portion...
6 times the normal amount."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
All the sweet and sour pork and fried rice I can eat...
Chances like this don't come around often, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, this is clearly over my calorie limit...
But I just can't resist Chinese food... Hmm...

Cheval Grand is brimming with love for Chinese food,
but an enormous mountain of sweet and sour pork and fried rice
would certainly pack a lot of calories.
choice_data_list: Remember... the true essence of Chinese cuisine!
I definitely wouldn't want to miss a chance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The... essence of Chinese cuisine...?
Umm... when it comes to Chinese food...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Sitting around a round table together, ordering whatever we want... that really is the best.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Putting small portions of various dishes onto the plate,
and enjoying it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, instead of just filling up on sweet-and-sour pork
and fried rice, I should lay out a whole variety
of dishes and savor them all...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hot and sour soup, boiled dumplings,
stir-fried eggs with wood ear mushrooms...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: How about... the "Balanced Chinese Set"?
choice_data_list: Then it'll be perfect for lunch!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I'll go place the order.
......Fufu... I can't wait...

And so, by eating a well-balanced meal,
Cheval Grand was fully satisfied while also keeping her calories in check.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yeah, you're right... If I let this chance
slip away, I'll end up dragging the regret with me forever..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I eat this every day.
Today is special... Call it an experience...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Alright,
I'll have the 'Sweet and Sour Pork Fried Rice Set,' mega-sized...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Munch, munch... munch, munch...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh...
I might be starting to feel a bit suffocated...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, since we have the chance,
I need to eat properly..."
And so, Cheval Grand successfully devoured the mountain of Chinese food!
